items.title: The localization of an abelian category at a multiplicative system is abelian
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file homology.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that localizing an abelian category at a left multiplicative system produces cokernels commuting with the localization functor, at a right multiplicative system produces kernels, and at a multiplicative system produces an abelian category with the localization functor exact (statement lines 2127-2141). The proof is a complete argument: part (1) reduces an arbitrary morphism of the localization to the image of a morphism of the original category and identifies its cokernel through the cited lemma on limits (proof lines 2144-2152); part (2) is dual; and part (3) combines the two and reduces the coincidence of coimage and image to the original category (proof lines 2157-2164). The non-formal content is the reduction to a morphism in the image of the functor. The claim is H2: a structured argument with each input named.
